data.title: 星熊 · 旧唱片
data.description: 唱片封套有些旧了，她抽出唱片仔细放好。第一段旋律响起来时，星熊靠回椅背，跟着打起节拍。
data.promptProse: In the golden glow of a quiet sunset, Hoshiguma carefully lowers the needle onto a vintage turntable resting on a dark wood credenza. Dusty amber light spills through sheer curtains across an eclectic living room filled with potted ferns, vinyl sleeves leaning against the wall, and the warm patina of aged wooden furniture as mellow music begins to play.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside a dark wood credenza in dusty amber sunset light, she carefully lowers the tonearm needle onto a vintage turntable. Sheer curtains soften the late glow across vinyl sleeves and potted ferns.
